zh:
GUI 与完整播放组件包均升级至 1.2.2，请配套更新。

GUI：修复部分 Demo 的按键变化和子 Tick 解析；改进播放组件安装、修复与回滚，保留配置和录制数据；更准确地识别组件不配套、重复插件及冲突来源。

播放插件：修复初始化崩溃、停止与交还控制时的重复清理，以及循环回放中事件、投掷物和自动语音／聊天的同步问题；修复断线、换队和接管时的身份与饰品状态干扰；改进 Randomizer 开关和开场探员显示，优先使用 Demo 记录的外观；移除多余的分队、复活和全局清理。

旧档案仍可播放；新转换的 .dtr v10 档案需要新版播放组件。要获得输入解析修复，请从原始 Demo 重新转换；旧档案无需强制重转。
en:
The GUI and complete playback bundle are both updated to 1.2.2. Update them together.

GUI: Fixed button-change and subtick parsing in some demos. Improved playback installation, repair, and rollback while preserving configuration and recordings. Improved detection of mismatched components, duplicate plugins, and conflict sources.

Playback: Fixed initialization crashes, repeated cleanup during stop and handoff, and event, projectile, and automatic voice/chat synchronization in replay loops. Fixed identity and cosmetic interference on disconnect, team changes, and takeover. Improved Randomizer settings and round-intro agents while prioritizing demo-backed appearance. Removed redundant team assignment, respawn, and global cleanup.

Existing archives remain playable. Newly converted .dtr v10 archives require the updated playback bundle. Reconvert the original demo to benefit from the input parsing fixes; recreating existing archives is otherwise optional.
